Liam C.: Heads up — AcmeHealth seeing intermittent 5xxs and 95th pct token latency spikes after last night's v2 routing rollout. CS flagged as potential SLA breach. Rolling stack snippet below. @Eva G. can you triage? (P0)

Liam C.: ```
2026-03-16T03:22:17Z ERROR request_id=sh-93a model=v2-routing tokens_ms=2410 status=502 kernel=cpu_fallback
2026-03-16T03:29:04Z ERROR request_id=sh-99f model=v2-routing tokens_ms=2743 status=500 kernel=cpu_fallback
```

deploy-bot: Deployment v2-routing finished at 2026-03-16T03:12:08Z -> canary 25%

Eva G.: ack, looking. Can you paste exact request IDs or customer session IDs? I'll check routing metrics.

Liam C.: Session IDs: sh-93a, sh-99f. Occurred ~03:22,03:29 UTC. Customer is asking for ETA on mitigation — they have an hourly SLA. :frowning:

Priya S.: I see elevated KV cache misses and token lat > 2s on those requests, likely due to model sharding falling back to CPU path. Quick test: reverting routing to model-v1 reduces latency. Suggest rolling back canary while we investigate. @Samir K. can you approve rollback?

Samir K.: Oncall: Rolling back canary now. ETA ~8m. Notifying infra. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: v2-routing -> canary 0% (started 1790123510)...

Eva G.: Thanks. I'll open a scoped debug PR to add logging for model variant selection and routing policy. Assigning to @Priya S. and @Eva G. for root cause. Priya, can you validate kernel selection path with the failing request IDs?

Priya S.: Will do. Quick note: patch candidate is to force compatible quantized kernel for v2 models to avoid CPU fallback. If that works, we can push a hotfix in <24h. I'll try reproducing locally now.

Maria R.: Product: informing customer and offering a temporary SLA credit if we exceed threshold. Keep me updated on ETA for hotfix.

Liam C.: Customer notified. They asked for a workaround: route their traffic to dedicated pool /model-v1 until fix. Is that feasible without config change on their side?

Eva G.: We can create a per-customer routing override in the console (route -> pinned-model). I can do that as temporary workaround for AcmeHealth. Need written approval in thread to make change to their live routing.

Liam C.: They approved. Please proceed.

Eva G.: Done — pinned AcmeHealth -> model-v1 at 03:41 UTC. Monitor for errors.

Priya S.: Repro produced. CPU fallback seen when quantized kernel selection fails due to dtype mismatch. Draft hotfix: adjust kernel selector to prioritize int8 path when model metadata reports quantization=8. Pushed PR: #2043. Requesting code review ping @Eva G. for platform config change. Small snippet: ```python
def choose_kernel(meta):
    if meta['quant'] == 8:
        return 'int8_kernel'
    # fallback
    return 'generic_kernel'
```

Eva G.: Reviewing PR now. If tests pass, we can cut hotfix to canary in non-peak window. Let's schedule canary for 10:00 UTC tomorrow. @Samir K. please coordinate. Also add perf unit to ensure no regressions.

Samir K.: Ack. I'll add to runbook and set pager threshold to 2xx latency alert. Also creating incident ticket INC-2026-78. Linking to thread.

Liam C.: Thanks team. For our SLA reporting, I'll update CS doc after incident closes. Quick ask: please post the final RCA and rollback time in this thread so I can attach. :+1:
